chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu al-Maghra', from Abu Basir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Is it permissible for the heir to make a will?' He said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Can an heir make a will for their own share of the inheritance in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility of an heir making a will for their own portion, resolving the juristic debate regarding whether the general prohibition of a will by an heir applies to their specific share. This ruling highlights the flexibility within Shia fiqh, allowing heirs to dispose of their inherited assets as they see fit, provided it does not infringe upon the fixed shares of other heirs. The brevity of the report underscores its status as a foundational principle in the chapter of *Wasiyyah* (wills).
